releaseNotes: XPoint feature port: mandatory Ed25519 online-update signatures, 20% update battery minimum, per-book WPM, opt-in power-off after sleep, timezone detection during Sync, EPUB trailing-data tolerance and download Wi-Fi power-save fix. Test release; physical validation pending. Auto power-off defaults Off. Existing time-remaining estimates preserved. Timezone offset refreshed on Sync, not automatic offline DST.
